description: This file defines the FavoritesController class which handles HTTP requests related to favoriting articles, including adding and deleting favorites. It uses dependency injection for IMediator, and leverages ASP.NET Core MVC attributes for routing and authorization.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core MVC controller responsible for managing favorite articles, including adding and removing favorites.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to add an article to favorites based on the slug.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove an article from favorites based on the slug.
